title: GPT-5.5 Generally Available
description: GPT-5.5 is now generally available for all GitHub Copilot users, bringing improved code generation and assistance capabilities.

title: Inline Agent Mode for JetBrains IDEs
description: Inline agent mode is now available in preview for JetBrains IDEs, allowing developers to use Copilot's agentic capabilities directly within their JetBrains development environment.

title: Copilot Chat Improvements for Pull Requests
description: GitHub Copilot Chat now offers enhanced capabilities for working with pull requests, helping developers review and understand code changes more effectively.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Generally Available
description: Claude Opus 4.7 by Anthropic is now generally available in GitHub Copilot, providing developers with access to one of the most advanced AI models for coding assistance.

title: Inception Labs Mercury-2 Model Support
description: Continue added support for Inception Labs' mercury-2 model, expanding the available AI models for code autocomplete and chat features in the IDE extension.
